_comment: DESADV (DELIVERY_REQUEST_OUT) CustomerSalesArea / PartnerFunction lookup set. From extract_tpz.py analysis of MM_CO_EDI_DELIVERY_REQUEST_OUT_cdm__2__DESADV. PI key+nav A_CustomerSalesArea(Customer=,SalesOrganization=,DistributionChannel=,Division=)/to_PartnerFunction reformulated as entity-set A_CustSalesPartnerFunc + composite $filter; PartnerFunction is a PASSED filter key (caller sends 'SH' ship-to / 'CR' carrier) so one iFlow serves both. NOTE: PI's CR call additionally did server-side 'Supplier eq <x>'; a single baked $filter can't add that for CR only, so Supplier is returned in the result instead (consumer filters). A_Customer('K')/to_CustomerSalesArea -> A_CustomerSalesArea filtered by Customer. Generate: gen-lookups <outdir> <this> <cpi-lookup-template/skeleton/LOOKUP_TEMPLATE>

lookups.name: LOOKUP_CUSTSALES_PARTNERFUNC
lookups.description: DESADV: resolve a customer-sales-area partner by PartnerFunction (e.g. SH ship-to, CR carrier) from API_BUSINESS_PARTNER/A_CustSalesPartnerFunc. Filter keys: Customer (BuyerPartyID), SalesOrganization, DistributionChannel, Division, PartnerFunction. Returns the partner (BPCustomerNumber / CustomerPartnerDescription / Supplier).
lookups.filter: Customer eq '${header.Customer}' and SalesOrganization eq '${header.SalesOrganization}' and DistributionChannel eq '${header.DistributionChannel}' and Division eq '${header.Division}' and PartnerFunction eq '${header.PartnerFunction}'

lookups.name: LOOKUP_CUSTOMER_SALESAREA
lookups.description: DESADV: get the sales area(s) (SalesOrganization/DistributionChannel/Division) for a customer from API_BUSINESS_PARTNER/A_CustomerSalesArea (PI: A_Customer('K')/to_CustomerSalesArea).
